chunks: On skazal: Abul' Kasim Dzha'far ibn Mukhammad ibn Kaulavajkh, da pomiluet ego Allakh, soobshchil mne ot svoego ottsa, ot Sa'da ibn Abdillakh, ot Akhmada ibn Abu Abdillakh al'-Barki, Sulejman ibn Salema al'-Kindi rasskazal nam, ot Mukhammada ibn Saida ibn Gazvana i Isy ibn Abu Mansura, ot Abana ibn Tagliba, ot Abu Abdillakh Dzha'fara ibn Mukhammada, mir im, skazal:

Vzdokh opechalennogo nespravedlivost'yu po otnosheniyu k nam -- eto proslavlenie Allakha, ego trevoga za nas -- eto poklonenie, a sokhranenie nashikh tayn -- eto dzhikhad na puti Allakha. Zatem Abu Abdillakh, mir emu, skazal: Etot khadis dolzhen byt' napisan zolotom.

key_terms.جهاد في سبيل الله: Dzhikhad fi sabil Allah: bor'ba na puti Allakha

ai.seo_question: Chto skazal Imam Dzhafar as-Sadik o tekh, kto gorevit za Akhl al-Bayt?
ai.summary: Imam Dzhafar as-Sadik (mir emu) ob'yavlyaet tri dukhovnye nagrady dlya tekh, kto gorevit iz-za ugneteniya Akhl al-Bayt: ikh vzdokhi -- eto proslavlenie Allakha, ikh trevoga -- eto poklonenie, a sokhranenie nashikh tayn -- eto dzhikhad na puti Allakha. Zatem on podcherkivul, chto etot khadis dolzhen byt' napisan zolotom.
